description: This file defines an abstract class 'Properties' that encapsulates various visual and styling properties for chart elements, including colors, shadows, line styles, and effects, within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for setting, retrieving, and transforming these properties, serving as a base class for more specific chart property classes.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: An abstract class providing comprehensive management of chart element styling, including colors, shadows, line styles, and effects. It facilitates setting, copying, and transforming visual properties for use within chart rendering.

methods.name: getObjectState
methods.description: Returns whether the object is in an active state, primarily for minor gridlines.

methods.name: activateObject
methods.description: Sets the object state to active (true).

methods.name: pointsToXml
methods.description: Converts a floating point width value to an XML-compatible integer string using a fixed multiplier.

methods.name: xmlToPoints
methods.description: Converts an XML string back to a floating point width value.

methods.name: angleToXml
methods.description: Converts an angle in float to an integer string representing the angle in XML.

methods.name: xmlToAngle
methods.description: Converts an XML angle string back to a float.

methods.name: tenthOfPercentToXml
methods.description: Converts a percentage value to an XML string by scaling.

methods.name: xmlToTenthOfPercent
methods.description: Converts an XML percentage string back to float.

methods.name: setColorProperties
methods.description: Prepares an array of color properties including type, value, and alpha transparency.

methods.name: getShadowPresetsMap
methods.description: Retrieves the shadow preset parameters for a given preset index.

methods.name: getArrayElementsValue
methods.description: Accesses nested array elements via a sequence of keys.

methods.name: setGlowProperties
methods.description: Sets glow size and color properties for chart elements.

methods.name: getGlowProperty
methods.description: Retrieves glow size or color properties based on the input.

methods.name: getGlowColor
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object representing the glow color.

methods.name: getGlowSize
methods.description: Returns the current glow size.

methods.name: setGlowSize
methods.description: Sets the glow size.

methods.name: setSoftEdges
methods.description: Sets the soft edges size for the element.

methods.name: getSoftEdgesSize
methods.description: Gets the soft edges size.

methods.name: setShadowProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific shadow property, such as color or other attributes.

methods.name: setShadowProperties
methods.description: Configures comprehensive shadow properties including presets, color, blur, angle, and distance.

methods.name: setShadowPresetsProperties
methods.description: Sets shadow preset options based on a preset index.

methods.name: setShadowPropertiesMapValues
methods.description: Recursively updates shadow properties from a map.

methods.name: setShadowBlur
methods.description: Sets the blur radius for the shadow.

methods.name: setShadowAngle
methods.description: Sets the angle/direction of the shadow.

methods.name: setShadowDistance
methods.description: Sets the distance of the shadow from the object.

methods.name: getShadowColorObject
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object representing the shadow color.

methods.name: getShadowProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific shadow property or color.

methods.name: getShadowArray
methods.description: Returns the entire shadow properties array.

methods.name: getLineColor
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object for line color.

methods.name: setLineColorProperties
methods.description: Sets line color with optional alpha and type.

methods.name: getLineColorProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property of the line color.

methods.name: setLineStyleProperties
methods.description: Configures line style attributes like width, dash, cap, join, and arrow properties.

methods.name: getLineStyleArray
methods.description: Returns the current line style as an array.

methods.name: setLineStyleArray
methods.description: Sets multiple line style properties at once from an array.

methods.name: setLineStyleProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific line style property.

methods.name: getLineStyleProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific line style property or nested element.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowSize
methods.description: Returns arrow size configuration based on preset and size keys.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowParameters
methods.description: Returns specific arrow parameters.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the width of an arrow in line style.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of an arrow in line style.
